verifiedBoundaries: A complete native collector consumes its exact group and resets named definitions in that group for the next list.
Different raw definitions of the same name within one list create a native duplicate-content error even when typed citation aliases render the same source.
The same name may have a different raw body after its group collector without a duplicate-content error.
A selfcall after its group collector cannot borrow a full definition from the previous list.
A collector for another group does not reset this group.
readerLimits: Ordered marker bodies, group/name associations and list consumption remain exact. Raw duplicate-content conflicts are checked only within the same known group collector interval. Unknown emitters or unresolved enclosing owners remain explicit ambiguities.
